title: Comprehensive Audit & Complete Purge of Hidden Role/Stage Tool Hardcodes
commitMessage: feat(policy): purge role and stage tool hardcodes in favor of dynamic policy matrix
author: agent-retro-verifier
summary: Comprehensive audit and complete purge of hidden role and stage tool hardcodes: (1) Root cause: previous iterative patches introduced hardcoded whitelists (CVH_DEV_TOOLS) in agent.rs (filtering and runtime gating) and hardcoded role aliases in config.rs (sync_tool_policies_to_personas), violating the Two-Level Tool Policy Matrix invariant (§ 2.5); (2) Architectural fix: restored Tool Policy Matrix (.cvh/settings/tool-policy.json) and setting.allowed_tools as the sole authoritative deciders; (3) Replaced static role-to-stage aliases with dynamic persona -> column resolution across pipeline.json and boards.json; (4) Retained pure § 2.8 task card boundary enforcement (create_task, complete_task restricted to orchestrator/UI roles); (5) Corrected dev, review, and retro stage policy overrides (enabled web_search, web_fetch, subagent, subagent_bg; disabled task creation for dev/review/retro); (6) Added execution protocol in system prompt against premature final answer emission; (7) Verified via 116 passing unit tests, cargo clippy 0 warnings, and npx tsc --noEmit.

rootCauses.cause: Hardcoded Tool Whitelist Circumventing Policy Matrix
rootCauses.detail: CVH_DEV_TOOLS was hardcoded in agent.rs (get_agent_tools and execute_tool), stripping and rejecting tools regardless of .cvh/settings/tool-policy.json and setting.allowed_tools, preventing cvh-dev from utilizing permitted tools such as todo_write or web_fetch.
rootCauses.resolution: Removed CVH_DEV_TOOLS filtering and runtime checks. Tool permissions are now governed authoritatively by is_tool_allowed(tool_policy, ...) and agent_allows_tool(setting.allowed_tools, ...).

rootCauses.cause: Static Role-to-Stage Aliases in Policy Synchronization
rootCauses.detail: In config.rs (sync_tool_policies_to_personas), role names were mapped to stages via rigid static string checks (e.g. developer -> dev, reviewer -> review), failing when custom pipelines or arbitrary persona names were introduced.
rootCauses.resolution: Implemented dynamic persona -> column resolution by inspecting pipeline.json and boards.json for col.persona == role || col.id == role, falling back to conventions only for minimal setups.

rootCauses.cause: Stage Override Policy Inconsistencies and Role Boundary Violations
rootCauses.detail: tool-policy.json and toolPolicyStore.ts disabled web_search for dev and retro stages, preventing necessary technical research. Conversely, dev stage allowed create_task and complete_task, violating § 2.8 role boundaries.
rootCauses.resolution: Updated default overrides: enabled web_search, web_fetch, subagent, subagent_bg for dev, review, and retro stages; strictly disabled create_task and complete_task for non-orchestrator stages.
